items.text: Base bephuma bonke abantwana bakwa-Israyeli, inhlangano yabuthana njengomuntu munye kusukela kwaDani kuze kube seBeri Sheba kanye nezwe lakwaGileyadi kuJehova eMispa.
Kwasekubonakala izikhulu zabo bonke abantu bezizwe zonke zakwa-Israyeli ebandleni labantu bakaNkulunkulu, amadoda ayizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu amane angumgundatshani, arhola inkemba.
Abantwana bakwaBenjamini bezwa ukuthi abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bakhuphukele eMispa. Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bathi: “Sitsheleni ukuthi lobu bubi bebunjani na?”
UmLevi, indoda yowesifazane obuleweyo, waphendula wathi: “Ngifikile eGibeya yakwaBenjamini, mina nesancinza sami, ukuba silale khona.
Abantu baseGibeya bangivukela, bahaqa indlu nxazonke zami ebusuku, befuna ukungibulala; isancinza sami sabaphoqa ukuthi sifile.
Ngasithatha isancinza sami, ngisihlahlela, ngasithuma ezweni lonke lefa lakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba babenzile ihlazo nobuwula kwa-Israyeli.
Bhekani, nina nonke ningabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; nikeza iseluleko neseluleko sakho lapha.
Bonke abantu basukuma njengamuntu munye, bathi: “Asiyikuya etendeni lakhe, futhi asiyikungena endlini yakhe.”
Kepha manje kuyakuba njalo ngeGibeya; sizomasha ngokumelene nalo ngokudalelwa;

Siyakuthatha amadoda ayishumi kwayikhulu kuzo zonke izizwe zakwa-Israyeli, nekhulu enkulungwaneni nasenkulungwaneni ezinkulungwaneni eziyishumi, ukuba ahambe atholele abantu ukudla, abangakwenza lapho befika eGibeya. KwaBenjamini, njengakho konke ubuwula ababenza kwa-Israyeli.
Bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli babuthana emzini, beboshiwe njengamuntu munye.
Izizwe zakwa-Israyeli zathuma amadoda esizweni sonke sakwaBenjamini, ukuba athi: “Bububi buni lobu obenziwe phakathi kwenu na?
Manje siphe amadoda, amadodana kaBheliyali, aseGibeya, ukuze siwabulale, sisuse ububi kwa-Israyeli. Kepha abantwana bakwaBenjamini abavumanga ukulalela izwi labafowabo, abantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
Kepha abantwana bakwaBenjamini babuthana emizini yaseGibeya ukuba baphume ukulwa nabantwana bakwa-Israyeli.

Abantwana bakwaBenjamini babalwa ngaleso sikhathi bephuma emizini, bephuma emizini, baba ngamadoda ayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nesithupha ahloma inkemba, ngaphandle kwabemi baseGibeya, ababalwayo baba ngamadoda akhethiweyo angamakhulu ayisikhombisa.
Phakathi kwalaba bantu bonke kwakukhona amadoda angamakhulu ayisikhombisa akhethiwe angamanxele; yilowo nalowo wayengajikijela amatshe ububanzi bezinwele, angageji.
Amadoda akwa-Israyeli, ngaphandle kukaBenjamini, abalwa amadoda ayizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu amane ahloma inkemba; bonke babengamaqhawe.

Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli basebezilungisa, bakhuphukela endlini kaNkulunkulu, bacela iseluleko kuNkulunkulu, bathi: “Ngumuphi kithi ozokhuphukela kuqala ukulwa nabantwana bakwaBenjamini na?” UJehova wathi: “UJuda makakhuphuke kuqala.”
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli baqeda ekuseni bamisa ngaseGibeya.
Amadoda akwa-Israyeli aphuma ukulwa noBenjamini; amadoda akwa-Israyeli azihlela ukulwa nawo eGibeya.
Abantwana bakwaBenjamini baphuma eGibeya, babulala kwa-Israyeli ngalolo suku abantu abayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nambili.
Abantu, amadoda akwa-Israyeli, baziqinisa, babuye bahlela impi endaweni ababehleleke kuyo ngosuku lokuqala.

Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bakhuphuka bakhala phambi kukaJehova kwaze kwahlwa, bacela iseluleko kuJehova bathi: “Ngiphinde ngenyuke ngiyokulwa nabantwana bakwaBhenjamini, umfowethu na?” Khona-ke uJehova wathi: “Khuphukani ngiyokulwa naye.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli basondela ukulwa nabantwana bakwaBenjamini ngosuku lwesibili.
UBenjamini waphuma eGibeya ukulwa nabo ngosuku lwesibili, wabuye wachitha abantu abayizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili ezweni labantwana bakwa-Israyeli; bonke bahosha izinkemba zabo.

Bonke abantwana bakwa-Israyeli nabo bonke abantu bakhuphukela endlini kaNkulunkulu, bakhala, bahlala phansi phambi kukaJehova, bazila ukudla ngalolo suku kwaze kwahlwa, banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa neminikelo yokubonga phambi kukaJehova. NKOSI.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli babuza kuJehova, ngokuba umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu wawulapho ngalezo zinsuku;

UFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare, indodana ka-Aroni, wema phambi kwakhe ngalezo zinsuku, wathi: “Ngiphinde ngiphume ukulwa nabantwana bakwaBhenjamini, umfowethu, noma ngiyeke?” Wayesethi uJehova: “Yenyuka; ngoba kusasa ngizawanikela esandleni sakho.
U-Israyeli waqamekela iGibeya nxazonke.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bakhuphuka ukulwa nabantwana bakwaBenjamini ngosuku lwesithathu, bazihlelela ukulwa neGibeya njengakuqala.

Abantwana bakwaBenjamini baphuma ukulwa nabantu, basuswa emzini; baqala ukuhlasela nokubulala abanye babantu njengakuqala emigwaqweni emikhulu, omunye wabo okhuphukela endlini kaNkulunkulu, omunye eGibeya endle, kungathi amadoda angamashumi amathathu akwa-Israyeli.
Base bethi abantwana bakwaBenjamini: “Banqotshiwe phambi kwethu njengakuqala; Kepha abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bathi: “Masibaleke, sibadonsele emigwaqweni besuka emzini.”
Wonke amadoda akwa-Israyeli asuka endaweni yawo, azihlela eBali Tamari;
Kwasekufika eGibeya amadoda akhethiweyo azinkulungwane ezilitshumi kuIsrayeli wonke, impi yayinzima, kodwa babengazi ukuthi ububi buphezu kwabo.
UJehova wahlula uBenjamini phambi kuka-Israyeli; abantwana bakwa-Israyeli babulala kwaBenjamini ngalolo suku izinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu nekhulu; bonke bahosha izinkemba zabo.
Abantwana bakwaBenjamini babona ukuthi banqotshiwe, ngokuba amadoda akwa-Israyeli ahlubuka kwabakwaBenjamini, ngokuba babethembele kwabaqamba amanga ababehlezi ngaseGibeya.
Abaqamba amanga bashesha bagijimela eGibeya; abaqamba amanga babuthana ndawonye, babulala umuzi wonke ngosiko lwenkemba.
Kwakukhona isibonakaliso phakathi kwamadoda akwa-Israyeli nabaqambimanga ababelindele ukushunqa umusi omkhulu emzini.

Amadoda akwa-Israyeli ahlehla ekulweni, uBenjamini waqala ukubulala, kungathi amadoda angamashumi amathathu amadoda akwa-Israyeli; ngokuba bathi: Ngempela, bahlulwa phambi kwethu njengasempini yokuqala.
Kwathi lapho ilangabi liqala ukunyuka liphuma emzini nensika yomusi, abakwaBenjamini babheka emva kwabo, bheka, ilangabi lomuzi likhuphukela ezulwini.
Lapho amadoda akwa-Israyeli ephenduka, amadoda akwaBhenjamini amangala, ngoba abona ukuthi ububi bubehlele.
Yingakho bafulathela phambi kwamadoda akwa-Israyeli endleleni eya ehlane; kodwa impi yabafica; abaphuma emizini bababhubhisa phakathi kwayo.
Bahaqa abakwaBenjamini nxazonke, babaxosha, babanyathela ngokukhululeka ngaseGibeya ekuphumeni kwelanga.
Kwawa kwaBenjamini amadoda ayizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili; bonke babengamadoda anesibindi.
Baphenduka babalekela ehlane edwaleni lakwaRimoni; baxosha baze bafika eGidomi, babulala kubo abayizinkulungwane ezimbili.
Bonke abawa ngalolo suku kwaBenjamini babe ngamadoda ayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu ahlome inkemba; bonke babengamadoda anesibindi.
Kepha abantu abangamakhulu ayisithupha baphenduka, babalekela ehlane edwaleni lakwaRimoni, bahlala edwaleni lakwaRimoni izinyanga ezine.

Amadoda akwa-Israyeli abuyela kubantwana bakwaBenjamini, ababulala ngosiko lwenkemba, namadoda akuleyo naleyo mizi, njengezilwane, nabo bonke abafika esandleni; bathungela yonke imizi ngomlilo abafike kukho.
